title: This AI Turns Figma Into A Real Website 🤯💻
description:
I discovered Locofy, a tool that helps developers turn UI designs into working code 💻🤖

You can import designs from Figma, use Locofy to generate code, and then customize and refine the result instead of manually rebuilding the entire interface.

It can speed up the workflow between designers and developers and make it much easier to go from a visual concept to a functional website or app.

If you're into Figma, web development, or AI-powered coding, Locofy is definitely worth checking out.
